elements.el: Title: kind, phrase, flow, forge and row number
Open in Runs keeps the scheduler id or raw trigger index

Last 24 hours: count, metered spend, last five runs, and queued jobs
Incomplete history and partially metered spend are named
Deployment defaults and every run field, set or unset
Explicit merge permission is a true-only By hand row
elements.reason: Issue #908 shows the reviewed opt-in without adding a setter; the card’s separate enabled example leaves its shared trigger fixture unchanged.

elements.el: Enabled trust text names the flow instruction and forge requirements
elements.shows: This trigger permits merging through the forge’s checks and approvals when its flow or operator instructions ask for it.
elements.reason: Issue #908 changes this sentence only for explicitly enabled triggers.

elements.el: Enabled queued-job note names unchanged authority and no later promotion
elements.shows: A queued job with merge permission runs only while its reviewed trigger remains unchanged. A job queued without it does not gain permission from a later edit.
elements.reason: Issue #908 keeps the default fixture’s note unchanged and explains the enabled policy’s stricter current-trigger check.
